decisions.reason: It is closely related to our existing compact site equipment, so our prior engineering, service and customer knowledge make it easy to learn from early demand and improve it through in-house R&D.

As an articulated construction dumper that builds directly on our established offer, it fits our accumulated know-how and installed commercial-service capabilities, which lowers the chance of withdrawal.

Because the underground mine rescue vehicle is relatively distant from our core product knowledge, the feedback and technical requirements are harder for us to absorb and refine efficiently, making resource reallocation the more likely choice.

This telescopic loader line is strongly connected to our existing machinery competences and the several-model rollout suggests enough internal knowledge and commitment to continue learning and scaling rather than exit.
